label: Navigating Psychiatric Concerns in a Veteran Reporting Gulf War Illness: A Case Report.
summary: Gulf War illness (GWI) is a chronic condition affecting nearly a third of Gulf War veterans and is characterized by persistent symptoms across a number of physical and neuropsychiatric domains. This case study examined a 52-year-old veteran admitted on a psychiatric hold for danger to others.
